rule_interpretation: AUTHORING.md requires actual release-time assessment and permits early-local releases before UTC midnight. The accepted source workflow explicitly preserves canonical publisher-vintage limits. Dated event-clock corroboration resolves a release-availability question; it does not silently resolve an article-version question. The existing dated secondary CPI calendar was sufficient for bounded scheduled-availability support under that workflow; exact official historical metadata now corroborates it.
retention: JSON caches contain actual connected-web tool responses and source/ref metadata, not original full HTTP response bytes. Failed/blocked opens remain recorded; no alternate network route was used to bypass policy. Irrelevant search results, current sidebars, later revisions, intraday reactions and later comments are excluded from the adjudication.
